name: ZooMeet
author: Sovlix

sections.description:
Enhance your virtual meetings, webinars, and online classes by integrating Zoom Meeting with ZooMeet a flexible video conferencing plugin for WordPress.

ZooMeet helps you schedule and manage meetings directly from your WordPress dashboard. It supports Zoom Meeting integration and is suitable for educational institutions, online events, and remote teams.

Key Features

Zoom Meeting Integration
* Seamless integration with Zoom Meeting
* Host unlimited meetings directly from your WordPress dashboard
* Manage Zoom Users and Access Reports
* List and Access Recordings
* Show User Recordings Based on Zoom Account
* Use personal meeting IDs and list registrants
* Manage Zoom meetings, webinars, and recordings

Customizable & User-Friendly
* Easy setup and management for instant meetings
* Fully customizable shortcodes for embedding meetings
* Compatible with Elementor and Gutenberg

Built for Developers
* Fully customizable source code for advanced developers
* Use Gutenberg blocks and Elementor widgets to simplify meeting management

Additional Features

  • Custom Meeting Thumbnails for better branding
  • Table view and board view for meeting lists
  • Countdown Timer for upcoming meetings and webinars
  • Enhanced branding options with custom meeting URLs
  • Privacy-focused user-specific meetings

External Services

This plugin connects to Zoom API services to provide video conferencing functionality. It’s required to create, manage, and join Zoom meetings and webinars.

What data is sent and when:
* User authentication credentials (API key, secret) for Zoom API access
* Meeting details (title, description, date, time, participants) when creating/updating meetings
* User information (name, email) when joining meetings or registering for webinars
* Meeting usage data and reports when accessing analytics

Zoom Services Used:
* Zoom API v2: For creating, managing, and accessing Zoom meetings and webinars
* Zoom Web SDK: For embedding meetings directly in web browsers
* Service Provider: Zoom Video Communications, Inc.
* Terms of Service: https://zoom.us/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://zoom.us/privacy

Data is transmitted securely via HTTPS whenever you create meetings, join meetings, or access meeting reports through this plugin.

Source Code

This plugin includes minified/compressed JavaScript and CSS files for optimal performance. All source code is available within the plugin itself in the assets/src directory.

Source Code Location:
* Source files: assets/src/ (uncompressed React/JS/CSS)
* Built files: assets/dist/ (minified/compressed)
* Zoom SDK files: assets/js/zoom/ (added manually from Zoom Web SDK)
* CSS: assets/css/vendor.css

Build Process:
This plugin uses React components and modern JavaScript that requires compilation. We’ve included both package.json and composer.json files so anyone can build the assets if changes are needed.

To build from source:
1. Navigate to the plugin directory
2. Run npm install to install dependencies
3. Run npm run build to compile and minify assets
4. Compiled files will be generated in assets/dist

Included Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

  • Zoom Web SDK
    • Used for embedding Zoom meetings directly in the browser
    • Source: https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/sdk/native-sdks/web/
    • License: Refer to Zoom’s SDK license terms
    • Location: assets/js/zoom/

These libraries are bundled for the plugin’s functionality and are not modified from their original source.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zoomeet directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ZooMeet settings to configure your Zoom API credentials.
  4. Start creating and managing your Zoom meetings.
sections.faq:
How do I get Zoom API credentials?

You need to create a Zoom App in the Zoom Marketplace and get your API key and secret. Detailed instructions are provided in the plugin settings.

Can I customize the meeting appearance?

Yes, you can customize meeting thumbnails, layout styles, and use shortcodes to embed meetings anywhere on your site.

Does this work with Gutenberg and Elementor?

Yes, ZooMeet includes both Gutenberg blocks and Elementor widgets for easy integration.
